About Me

Driven by curiosity,
built on precision.

I am G. Vetrivel, a 3rd year B.Tech Bioinformatics student at TamilNadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore. I am passionate about unlocking the secrets encoded in biological sequences and building computational tools that make genomic research more accessible and impactful.

My experience as a Docling Intern at Biogencodex has given me hands-on exposure to real-world bioinformatics workflows. I thrive at the intersection of biology and computing, with strong skills in Python, R, and core bioinformatics techniques including sequencing, genome assembly, and annotation.
